jobs.title: Global Product Manager-NDT Sensors (based in State College, PA)
jobs.description:
The Global Product Manager is a critical role within the Evident Test & Measurement Global Product Management & Marketing (PMM) organization.  Reporting to the Director, Global Product Management for the assigned product line, this role is responsible for sustaining and growing the market share of their assigned products or product lines, encompassing connected devices, software, and digital workflow solutions strategies, while maintaining a long-term vision to meet market needs.
The Global Product Manager will monitor and report on the development of assigned Product and/or Product Line P&L against targets and key product market share development globally, as well as within regions and targeted market segments.  In this effort, this role will ensure close coordination with the Director, Global Product Management, as well as with the Director, Global Product Marketing and their regional team members.
The Global Product Manager will benefit from enhanced market intelligence data (VoC, VoS, win/loss root cause analysis, industry trends, market share, market opportunity in targeted segments, competitor activities/trends) that is regularly collected and reported to the Global PMM leadership team.  It is critical that the Global Product Manager utilizes this enhanced market intelligence data to focus our efforts toward Innovation that Matters.  The Product Management team must continually refine our development strategies and priorities to create products and solutions based upon what actually matters to our customers.
The Global Product Manager is responsible for the development and maintenance of their assigned Product and/or Product Line Strategies and Product Road Maps (PRM).  This activity will be coordinated with the Director, Global Product Management.  Together, they will designate Global Working Groups comprised of team members from Global Product Marketing, Sales, Application Engineering, and R&D to validate and refine Product Line Strategies and Product Road Maps (PRM).

The Global Product Manager will have management responsibilities for direct reports. Lead and oversee team performance to ensure efficiency and alignment with organizational objectives.

The Global Product Manager is responsible for regular collaboration and coordination with R&D to ensure that PRM projects are well executed, and for execution of Product Launch / NPI activities with Winning Go-To-Market strategies and unparalleled Unique Customer Value Propositions.  Launch / NPI activities must be well-coordinated with Product Marketing, Global Marketing Communications, Application Engineering and Sales.

Job Duties
Product Roadmap Development and Management:
- - Development and maintenance of a detailed Product Road Map (PRM) for the assigned product and/or product line(s).  Provide clear specifications for development projects as well as clear prioritization of features/functions to direct product development, production, and launch.
- Provide updated Product Road Map documentation on a quarterly basis, taking into account actual project status and impacts.
- Collaborate with R&D leaders and Program Management Office to ensure that PRM plans are regularly updated in OnePlan tool.  This activity is critical to allow for development prioritization, planning, budgeting, and overall project execution.
- Under the direction of the Director, Global Product Management, participate proactively in building relationships with strategic key accounts and opinion leaders who will influence broader market acceptance (such as OEM & Asset Owner who define the to-be testing standards) to drive growth in the long-run, fuel product development efforts and ensure relevance of strategic plans.

Long-term Product Planning:
- - Market Opportunity Identification: Working with Product Marketing & Sales to conduct market analysis to identify opportunities and key market and customer segments, and to gather information on customers and competitors.
- Anticipate market trends and plan the lifecycle of assigned products, including launch, maturity, and sunsetting.
- Close collaboration with Supply Chain and Manufacturing to coordinate the product sunsetting process, ensuring proper part availability for service to EOL, and minimizing extra inventory to be scrapped after sales and service activities end.

Development of Winning Go-to-Market Strategies and Launch Materials (NPI Packages):
- - Lead the New Product Introduction (NPI) process start-to-finish, working with stakeholders to meet launch deadlines. Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop requirements for global & regional marketing campaigns to ensure successful market introduction and sustainment.
- Value Proposition and Message Definition: Collaborate with Product Marketing to define the value proposition for new products and support the development of key messages for marketing campaigns.
- Creating content of all detailed documents for product launches, including technical data sheets, user manuals, competitive analysis, and sales support materials.
- Align with Marketing Communications on web and collateral plans for launch.

Product P&L Monitoring:
- P&L monitoring and reporting of the assigned product(s) and/or product line(s), including all strategic planning through to market launch and product life cycle, as well as third-party strategic partnerships.
- Coordinating with different teams to ensure optimal product vitality and performance, while maintaining a long-term vision to meet market needs.
- Focus on ensuring that correct market pricing is implemented for all key products in each region to maximize sales volume and revenue.  Collaborate with Product Marketing on validation of pricing, and with Sales Management team to ensure execution.
- Monitor key product cost on a monthly basis (or as needed) to ensure that changes are detected and impact to profitability are understood.  Collaborate with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and other stakeholders to address issues, and to drive initiatives to improve profitability.
- Focus on Service offerings that are related to assigned product lines.  Set expectations for product support periods, spares pricing, service contract offerings, etc.  Support implementation within regional service organizations
- Lead the development of new business models within and adjacent to assigned core product lines.  Focus on opportunities for the development of recurring revenue business models, including SaaS / PaaS / HaaS.  Close collaboration with Product Marketing team and Digital Services team is expected to drive a wholistic approach to this effort across the TNM business.
- Act as the key approver for all assigned product pricing.  Work with stakeholders at the global and regional level to ensure efficient pricing implementation processes are in place.

Talent Development:
- Work with Product Specialists within the Product Management team as assigned on a product or project basis.
- As a Product Manager, will manage direct reports and provide mentorship to more junior team members as they participate in project work (R&D, NPI, etc.)
- Suggest opportunities for market exposure (VoC, VoS, Exhibitions, etc.)
- Delegate project work as appropriate and in coordination with Director, Global Product Management and VP PMM

Reporting:
- Provide timely and complete roll-up of activities, KPIs, Problem Solving Process documents, and PDCA Action Plan improvement initiatives.
- Responsible to monitor, optimize and achieve product performance within business objectives. Responsible for monthly monitoring and analysis of actual achievement vs KPIs to identify requirements for improvement. Drive global solutions to achieve business goals.

Job Requirements
Education:
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or related field.

Experience:
- 5+ Years Product Management and/or Product Marketing Experience.
- Experience in Test and Measurement/Non-Destructive Testing is considered an advantage.
- 2+ years management experience.

Skills:
- Strong knowledge of inspection modalities related to assigned business line.
- Strong knowledge of the science & technology related to assigned business line.
- Outstanding written and oral communication skills, interpersonal skills in a multi-cultural environment, and an ability to effectively interact at a senior executive level.
- Proficiency in data analysis for strategy development, reporting, and presentation.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 tools
- Deep understanding of the Product Portfolio within the assigned product lines, competitive products, relative market position of Evident at the global and regional level.
- Excellent understanding of targeted markets, customer segments and customer needs for assigned business line.
- Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including English language, strong interpersonal skills and an ability to effectively interact at a senior executive level.
- Significant experience with NPI activities and driving marketing campaigns.

Other Considerations (travel/hours availability, etc.):
- Ability to travel internationally up to 30%.

Pay Range - $90,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year, depending on experience plus 12.5% annual bonus target.​
**Many Evident positions are located at export-control-restricted work locations or require access to export-controlled information. To be considered for these positions, you must be a U.S. Persons. If hired, you must be able to provide valid proof of such status.

jobs.title: Services Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we?
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 31K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit  our website  to learn more!
Who will you be working with?
As a Brake System Product Manager, you will work across the entire product lifecycle, supporting both Original Equipment (OE) and Services business objectives. You will collaborate with a diverse network of stakeholders responsible for developing, selling, delivering, and supporting our products throughout their lifecycle.
In this role, you will partner closely with Key Account Management, Business Development, Tendering, Commercial Operations (COM-OPS), Product Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, and Services teams within the region, while also working with global Product Management and Engineering teams to ensure alignment between regional market needs and global product strategy.
How will you make a difference?
As a member of the Brakes Product Management team, you will be responsible for defining and executing the strategy for your assigned product portfolio across its full lifecycle. Reporting to the Director, Brake System Product Management, you will help drive profitable growth by aligning product offerings with customer needs, market trends, and business priorities across both OE and Services markets.
You will own the product roadmap for your assigned portfolio, defining the strategic vision, market positioning, and competitive direction of your products. Through close collaboration with commercial, engineering, sourcing, and operations teams, you will translate customer and market requirements into differentiated solutions that deliver sustainable growth, improve competitiveness, and create long-term value for customers and the business.
What do we want to know about you?
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field
- Minimum of 3 years' experience in product management, engineering, sales, business development, or profit center (P&L) management, ideally in the rail industry or at an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
- Demonstrated experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, business cases and lifecycle offerings.
- Experience leading cross-functional work across Engineering, Operations, Sourcing, Finance and Commercial teams.

Other language requirement
Fluent English is required for this position in order to communicate with colleagues, clients and partners (or suppliers).
What will your typical day look like?
- Product strategy and roadmap:  Define the aftermarket vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for assigned product lines based on market entitlement, fleet lifecycle, technology evolution, customer requirements and competitive dynamics.
- Portfolio and offering management:  Define, develop and rationalize a scalable portfolio of “core” products, parts, upgrades and service solutions. Establish offering scope, target applications, configuration rules, value propositions and lifecycle plans.
- Product economics and profitable growth:  Own product-level business cases, target cost, margin architecture, lifecycle value and investment recommendations. Monitor orders, revenue, contribution margin, market share and pipeline health by assigned product, and initiate corrective actions with KAM, BD and functional teams, as deviations from targets exist.
- Innovation and competitiveness:  Identify product upgrade/evolution potential, cost-reduction opportunities and technology investments for assigned products. Lead cross-functional competitiveness improvements involving LCC, RAMS, engineering, manufacturing, methods, quality and others as required.
- Other responsibilities include: - Voice of market to requirements:  Synthesize inputs from Key Account Management (KAM), Business Development (BD), customer engagements, field performance, installed-base data and market research. Translate prioritized needs into clear product and service requirements with Product Engineering and other functions.
- OE lifecycle and Services readiness:  Drive lifecycle readiness for parts, tooling, documentation, repair capability, supplier strategy, training, warranty transition, fleet introduction and long-term support.
- Market and competitive intelligence:  Maintain product-specific market intelligence, fleet and installed-base visibility, competitor analysis and technology trends. Convert insights into roadmap priorities, offer positioning and risks/opportunities.
- Opportunity and proposal enablement:  Support BD and KAM with product expertise, requirements interpretation, technical positioning, business-case inputs and product risk assessment. Support Commercial Operations (COM-OPS) with necessary technical inputs to build/submit a quality offer for products and service.
- Standardization and governance:  Ensure tenders and projects use approved standard offerings wherever practical. Govern exceptions, product deviations and roadmap commitments in coordination with Engineering, Operations, Sourcing and Quality.
- Regional enablement:  Communicate product vision, roadmap and offer strategy to regional stakeholders. Provide product knowledge, tools and training that enable KAM and BD teams to identify, position and execute opportunities consistently.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Cubicles
jobs.description:
Have you set the course for the future? We’ll give you the green light!

Because at Frauscher, we always have our eyes firmly fixed on progress. Let’s embark on this journey together! Our agility and enthusiasm for new things are reflected in our innovative technologies and services – and, of course, also in our corporate culture. Join Frauscher now and start your career journey with the technology leader!

At Frauscher, we are dedicated to delivering the world’s most reliable train detection and wayside object control solutions. Our industry leading field elements, software, connectivity and data access solutions, combined with smart life cycle services, ensure system critical components are operational and provide the information rail operators need to maximise the safety, efficiency and capacity of their networks. We provide the trusted foundation operators need to run their rail networks, being "Your partner for confidence."

Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Product Owner – Cubicles to own the cubicle portfolio from customer requirements through product definition, standardization, configuration, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.
The role will ensure that products meet customer requirements while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, reliability, cost, and manufacturability.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the cubicle product portfolio and act as the key product contact across functions.

- Define the product roadmap based on customer, technology, and market needs.

- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams locally and globally to support product development and delivery.

- Define and maintain standard products, variants, options, and customer configurations while ensuring cost, quality, and manufacturability.

- Apply knowledge of electrical cubicles, railway signalling cabinets, wiring, and schematics in product decisions.

- Work with Engineering teams to standardize cubicle and wiring designs and ensure they are suitable for manufacturing, testing, maintenance, and field use.

- Maintain and manage product structures, BOMs, variants, options, and configuration rules in SAP ERP.

- Manage products throughout their lifecycle, including product introduction, revisions, improvements, product changes, and phase-out.

- Ensure products meet applicable railway, electrical, safety, IEC/EN, and customer requirements, and support testing, validation, certification, and compliance activities.

- Drive continuous improvement based on customer feedback, field performance, quality, reliability, cost, and market requirements.

Qualifications & Experience
- BE/B.Tech or MS/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering.

- 5+ years of relevant experience in product ownership, product management, electrical engineering, or cubicle development.

- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience in railway signalling or safety-critical products is preferred.

- Knowledge of applicable railway and IEC/EN standards is preferred.

In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Are you bursting with curiosity and creativity? Do you have brilliant ideas and want to set the course for the future, today? If so, embark on your Frauscher journey with us!

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de produits, Composants de matériel roulant (RSC) / Rolling Stock Components (RSC) Product Manager
jobs.description:
Il ne s’agit pas seulement de votre carrière ou de votre titre de poste… Il s’agit de qui vous êtes et de l’impact que vous aurez sur le monde. Car, que ce soit les uns pour les autres ou pour nos clients, nous accordons la priorité aux personnes. Lorsque nos collaborateurs se réunissent, nous élargissons ce qui est possible et recherchons continuellement des moyens d'améliorer ce que nous créons et la manière dont nous le faisons. Si vous cherchez constamment à grandir, vous êtes en bonne compagnie. Nous révolutionnons la façon dont le monde bouge pour les générations futures et nous voulons quelqu'un qui soit prêt à évoluer avec nous.

Qui sommes-nous?

Wabtec Corporation est l'un des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux d'équipements, de systèmes, de solutions numériques et de services à valeur ajoutée pour le transport de marchandises et le transport de passagers ainsi que pour les marchés minier, maritime et industriel. S'appuyant sur près de quatre siècles d'expérience collective au sein de Wabtec, GE Transportation et Faiveley Transport, l'entreprise s’est développée pour devenir « Un seul Wabtec », avec une expertise numérique inégalée, une innovation technologique ainsi qu'une fabrication et des services de classe mondiale, permettant le développement des écosystèmes numériques du transport ferroviaire et du transport en commun.

Wabtec se concentre sur la performance qui stimule le progrès et libère le potentiel de nos clients en proposant des solutions de transport innovantes et durables qui font bouger et améliorent le monde. Nous sommes des apprenants à vie obsédés par l’amélioration des choses pour obtenir des résultats exceptionnels. Wabtec compte environ 27 000 employés répartis dans des installations à travers le monde. Visitez notre site Web pour en savoir plus!

Avec qui allez-vous travailler ?
À titre de Gestionnaire de produits, Composants de matériel roulant (RSC), vous interviendrez dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des produits et contribuerez aux objectifs commerciaux des activités d'équipement d'origine (OE) et de services. Vous collaborerez avec un vaste réseau d'intervenants responsables du développement, de la vente, de la livraison et du soutien de nos produits tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de gestion des comptes clés, de développement des affaires, de soumissions, d'opérations commerciales (COM-OPS), d'ingénierie de produits, d'approvisionnement, d'exploitation et de services au sein de la région. Vous collaborerez également avec les équipes mondiales de gestion de produits et d'ingénierie afin d'assurer l'alignement entre les besoins des marchés régionaux et la stratégie globale des produits.

Comment allez-vous faire la différence ?
En tant que membre de l'équipe de gestion de produits RSC, vous serez responsable de définir et d'exécuter la stratégie de votre portefeuille de produits assigné tout au long de son cycle de vie. Relevant du directeur, Gestion de produits RSC, vous contribuerez à stimuler une croissance rentable en harmonisant l'offre de produits avec les besoins des clients, les tendances du marché et les priorités de l'entreprise dans les marchés OE et Services.
Vous serez responsable de la feuille de route des produits de votre portefeuille, en définissant la vision stratégique, le positionnement sur le marché et l'orientation concurrentielle de vos produits. Grâce à une collaboration étroite avec les équipes commerciales, d'ingénierie, d'approvisionnement et d'exploitation, vous traduirez les besoins des clients et du marché en solutions distinctives qui favorisent une croissance durable, améliorent la compétitivité et créent de la valeur à long terme pour les clients et l'entreprise.
Que voulons-nous savoir sur vous ?

- Baccalauréat en génie, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe; diplôme d'études supérieures ou MBA considéré comme un atout.
- Plus de 5 années d'expérience en gestion de produits, en ventes, en développement des affaires ou en gestion de centre de profits (P&L), idéalement dans l'industrie ferroviaire ou auprès d'un fabricant d'équipement d'origine (OEM).
- Expérience démontrée dans l'élaboration de stratégies de produits, de feuilles de route, d'analyses de rentabilité et d'offres couvrant tout le cycle de vie.
- Expérience de direction de projets multifonctionnels impliquant les équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, d'approvisionnement, de finances et commerciales.

- La connaissance du français est requise pour les postes situés en permanence au Québec afin que le titulaire puisse communiquer au besoin avec ses collègues et les fournisseurs au Québec. Une formation en français est offerte à tout titulaire d’un poste permanent au Québec qui ne possède pas une bonne connaissance du français.

Autre exigence linguistique
L’exigence de l’anglais est requis pour ce poste afin de pouvoir communiquer avec les clients, partenaires et collègues qui sont majoritairement situés à l’extérieur du Québec.

À quoi ressemblera votre journée type ?
Stratégie produit et feuille de route
- Définir la vision du marché secondaire (aftermarket), la stratégie et la feuille de route pluriannuelle des lignes de produits assignées en fonction du potentiel du marché, du cycle de vie des flottes, de l'évolution technologique, des exigences des clients et de la dynamique concurrentielle.

Gestion du portefeuille et des offres
- Définir, développer et rationaliser un portefeuille évolutif de produits, pièces, mises à niveau et solutions de services « de base ».
- Établir la portée des offres, les applications visées, les règles de configuration, les propositions de valeur et les plans de cycle de vie.

Rentabilité des produits et croissance profitable
- Assumer la responsabilité des analyses de rentabilité au niveau des produits, des coûts cibles, de l'architecture des marges, de la valeur du cycle de vie et des recommandations d'investissement.
- Suivre les commandes, les revenus, la marge contributive, la part de marché et la santé du pipeline de ventes pour les produits assignés, et mettre en œuvre des actions correctives avec les équipes KAM, BD et les autres fonctions lorsque des écarts sont constatés.

Innovation et compétitivité
- Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et d'évolution des produits, les occasions de réduction des coûts et les investissements technologiques.
- Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la compétitivité impliquant notamment les analyses de coûts du cycle de vie (LCC), RAMS, l'ingénierie, la fabrication, les méthodes, la qualité et d'autres fonctions pertinentes.

Autres responsabilités
Voix du marché et définition des exigences
- Synthétiser les informations provenant de la gestion des comptes clés (KAM), du développement des affaires (BD), des interactions avec les clients, des performances sur le terrain, des données de base installée et des études de marché.
- Traduire les besoins prioritaires en exigences claires de produits et de services avec les équipes d'ingénierie de produits et les autres fonctions.

Cycle de vie OE et préparation des services
- Assurer la préparation du soutien tout au long du cycle de vie : pièces, outillage, documentation, capacités de réparation, stratégie fournisseurs, formation, transition des garanties, mise en service des flottes et soutien à long terme.

Veille du marché et de la concurrence
- Maintenir une connaissance à jour du marché, de la flotte installée, des concurrents et des tendances technologiques propres aux produits.
- Transformer ces informations en priorités de feuille de route, en stratégies de positionnement et en évaluations des risques et opportunités.

Soutien aux opportunités et aux propositions
- Soutenir les équipes BD et KAM grâce à votre expertise produit, l'interprétation des exigences, le positionnement technique, les analyses de rentabilité et l'évaluation des risques liés aux produits.
- Fournir aux équipes COM-OPS les intrants techniques nécessaires pour élaborer et soumettre des offres de qualité concernant les produits et services.

Standardisation et gouvernance

Who will you be working with?
As a Rolling Stock Components (RSC) Product Manager, you will work across the entire product lifecycle, supporting both Original Equipment (OE) and Services business objectives. You will collaborate with a diverse network of stakeholders responsible for developing, selling, delivering, and supporting our products throughout their lifecycle.
In this role, you will partner closely with Key Account Management, Business Development, Tendering, Commercial Operations (COM-OPS), Product Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, and Services teams within the region, while also working with global Product Management and Engineering teams to ensure alignment between regional market needs and global product strategy.
How will you make a difference?
As a member of the RSC Product Management team, you will be responsible for defining and executing the strategy for your assigned product portfolio across its full lifecycle. Reporting to the Director, RSC Product Management, you will help drive profitable growth by aligning product offerings with customer needs, market trends, and business priorities across both OE and Services markets.
You will own the product roadmap for your assigned portfolio, defining the strategic vision, market positioning, and competitive direction of your products. Through close collaboration with commercial, engineering, sourcing, and operations teams, you will translate customer and market requirements into differentiated solutions that deliver sustainable growth, improve competitiveness, and create long-term value for customers and the business.

What do we want to know about you?
- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA preferred
- More than 5 years of experience in product management, sales, business development, or profit center (P&L) management, ideally in the rail industry or at an original equipment manufacturer (OEM).
- Demonstrated experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, business cases and lifecycle offerings.
- Experience leading cross-functional work across Engineering, Operations, Sourcing, Finance and Commercial teams.
- Knowledge of French is required for positions permanently located in Quebec so incumbents can communicate with their colleagues and partners in Quebec as necessary. French-language training is offered to all incumbents in permanent positions in Quebec who do not have a good knowledge of French.

Other language requirement
Fluent English is required for this position in order to communicate with colleagues, clients and partners (or suppliers) located outside Quebec and to understand the technical and scientific documentation available in fields relevant to our industry.

What will your typical day look like?
- Product strategy and roadmap: Define the aftermarket vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for assigned product lines based on market entitlement, fleet lifecycle, technology evolution, customer requirements and competitive dynamics.
- Portfolio and offering management: Define, develop and rationalize a scalable portfolio of “core” products, parts, upgrades and service solutions. Establish offering scope, target applications, configuration rules, value propositions and lifecycle plans.
- Product economics and profitable growth: Own product-level business cases, target cost, margin architecture, lifecycle value and investment recommendations. Monitor orders, revenue, contribution margin, market share and pipeline health by assigned product, and initiate corrective actions with KAM, BD and functional teams, as deviations from targets exist.
- Innovation and competitiveness: Identify product upgrade/evolution potential, cost-reduction opportunities and technology investments for assigned products. Lead cross-functional competitiveness improvements involving LCC, RAMS, engineering, manufacturing, methods, quality and others as required.
- Other responsibilities include: - Voice of market to requirements: Synthesize inputs from Key Account Management (KAM), Business Development (BD), customer engagements, field performance, installed-base data and market research. Translate prioritized needs into clear product and service requirements with Product Engineering and other functions.
- OE lifecycle and Services readiness: Drive lifecycle readiness for parts, tooling, documentation, repair capability, supplier strategy, training, warranty transition, fleet introduction and long-term support.
- Market and competitive intelligence: Maintain product-specific market intelligence, fleet and installed-base visibility, competitor analysis and technology trends. Convert insights into roadmap priorities, offer positioning and risks/opportunities.
- Opportunity and proposal enablement: Support BD and KAM with product expertise, requirements interpretation, technical positioning, business-case inputs and product risk assessment. Support Commercial Operations (COM-OPS) with necessary technical inputs to build/submit a quality offer for products and service.
- Standardization and governance: Ensure tenders and projects use approved standard offerings wherever practical. Govern exceptions, product deviations and roadmap commitments in coordination with Engineering, Operations, Sourcing and Quality.
- Regional enablement: Communicate product vision, roadmap and offer strategy to regional stakeholders. Provide product knowledge, tools and training that enable KAM and BD teams to identify, position and execute opportunities consistently.
